pages.name: Caro-Kann: Two Knights, 3...Bg4 4.h3 Bxf3 5.Qxf3 e6 6.d3 Nf6 7.a3
pages.notes: Plan 3 sent the queen to e2 or d1 ambiguously; plans 1 and 2 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Two Knights, 3...Bg4 4.h3 Bxf3 5.Qxf3 e6 6.g3 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 2 developed a light-squared bishop Black has already traded on f3; plan 3 sent the queen to h3, where White's pawn stands; the overview said ...Bxf3 disrupts White's structure. Rewrote overview and plans 2 and 3 (reviewer: first draft aimed ...c5 at a d4-pawn White doesn't have, revised, re-accepted).

pages.name: Caro-Kann - Botvinnik-Carls Defense - 4. c3
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f2-f4-f5 with Nf3 planned; plan 3 controlled c5 where Black's pawn stands and routed a knight via e1 with the king there; plan 2 called the d-pawn isolated. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Advance Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted the b1-knight via f1, where the rook stands; plan 3 said ...a5-a4 targets d4. Rewrote plans 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Advance Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 recaptured hxg6 before Nxg6; plan 4 rerouted the knight via f1, where the rook stands. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defence - Advance Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 routed a knight ...Nd7-f8-g6 with the f8-bishop still at home. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defence - Advance Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 had White recapture exd3 after its own bishop trade; plan 4 routed a knight via f8 with the bishop there; plan 1 pushed f2-f4-f5 into the e6-pawn. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defence - Advance Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f4-f5 with Nf3 planned; plan 3 recaptured hxg6 before Bxg6; plan 4 routed Ne2-g3 vaguely. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defence - Advance Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed Ne2-g3; the overview called 5.Qxd3 the Short Variation. Rewrote overview and plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defence - Advance Variation, 4.Nf3 e6 5.Be2
pages.notes: Plan 2 told Black to provoke c3 with a check already given; plans read c3, d7 and e7 as moves. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.
